critique: The code describes a strong, disciplined answer to the brief — three torn cobalt/bone/vermilion shapes with dry spray speckle, deckled 9px-jitter edges and one slow 28s shadow drift on ochre — and the constrained palette plus spare count is exactly the right instinct for graffiti-as-cut-paper. But the attached asset shows none of it: the actual rendered page is a blank white field with a tiny kawaii guinea-pig sticker at 18px, meaning the canvas pieces are absent and the only visible mark is an off-brief cartoon that contradicts the ochre ground, mid key, and spray-can vocabulary entirely.
